visual.name: smartvisualsResearch
visual.description: Survey results in Power BI like a research agency: Likert batteries, crosstabs with significance letters and NPS in one visual — weighted, tested, defensible. The multi-view flagship of the SmartVisuals Research suite.

cs-CZ.Visual_Caption_LetteredRows: {0} výsledků segmentů je významně vyšších než jiný segment.
cs-CZ.Visual_Caption_NpsGap: K dosažení {0}: o {1} příznivců více nebo o {1} kritiků méně.
cs-CZ.Visual_Caption_NpsNeedsN: Aby byla změna této velikosti významná, bylo by potřeba n≈{0} na vlnu.
cs-CZ.Visual_Caption_SigCount: {0} z {1} výroků se významně liší od ostatních.
cs-CZ.Visual_Caption_XtabSig: {0} z {1} testovaných buněk je významně vyšších než jiný sloupec.
cs-CZ.Visual_ExportCsv_Title: Stáhnout tabulku jako CSV včetně písmen
cs-CZ.Visual_Landing_Hint: Vyberte pohled — Likertova baterie, Křížová tabulka nebo NPS — a přidejte Otázku, Odpověď a Hodnotu (např. Count of RespondentID). Segment přidá porovnávané skupiny s písmeny signifikance, Vlna sleduje NPS v čase; vážené výsledky: použijte jako Hodnotu součet vah.
cs-CZ.Visual_Landing_ScaleHint: Pole Odpověď potřebuje kategorie škály (např. 1–5). Odpovědi mimo škálu označte jako N/A v Formát → Škála.
cs-CZ.Visual_Landing_ScoreHint: Pro pohled NPS musí pole Odpověď obsahovat skóre 0–10 ochoty doporučit.
cs-CZ.Visual_Legend_Arrows: ▲ ▼ = top box významně nad / pod ostatními výroky (spolehlivost {0} %).
cs-CZ.Visual_Legend_Index: Buňky = index vůči celku (100 = stejný podíl jako sloupec Celkem).
cs-CZ.Visual_Legend_Letters: A/B/C = významně vyšší než daný segment (spolehlivost {0} %); * = báze pod {1}, netestováno.
cs-CZ.Visual_Legend_LettersColumns: A/B/C = významně vyšší než daný sloupec (spolehlivost {0} %); * = báze pod {1}, netestováno.
cs-CZ.Visual_Legend_NpsChange: ✓ = změna vůči předchozí vlně je významná (spolehlivost {0} %); (n.s.) = nevýznamná.
cs-CZ.Visual_Legend_WaveDeltaTested: ▲ ▼ = změna vůči {0} v procentních bodech; ✓ = významná (spolehlivost {1} %).
cs-CZ.Visual_Nps_GapHint: K dosažení {0}: o {1} příznivců více nebo o {1} kritiků méně (n={2})
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_answer_desc: Scale answers in model sort order (use Sort By Column); for the NPS view the 0–10 likelihood-to-recommend score
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_benchmark_desc: Optional: a norm or benchmark for each statement's top box, as a fraction (0.62) or percent (62) — the delta shows next to the net
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_group_desc: Optional: the section a statement belongs to (Leadership, Tools, …) — drawn as a header with its pooled score
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_questionText_desc: Optional: the full wording behind a short question code — shown in tooltips, the caption and the footnote
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_question_desc: Likert and Crosstab: one row / table block per question. NPS: leave empty or filter to the recommend question
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_segment_desc: Optional (premium): comparison groups — Likert segments, Crosstab banner columns, NPS segments — with significance letters
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_value_desc: Respondent count — or Sum of Weight for weighted results
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_wave_desc: Optional: tracker mode — NPS trend over waves; Likert and Crosstab show the latest wave with the change since the previous one
cs-CZ.Visual_Role_weightsq_desc: Optional: SUM(weight²) enables effective bases for weighted significance testing
cs-CZ.Visual_Warn_Truncated_Title: Data dosáhla limitu řádků tohoto vizuálu

en-US.Visual_Caption_LetteredRows: {0} segment results are significantly higher than another segment.
en-US.Visual_Caption_NpsGap: To reach {0}: {1} more promoters or {1} fewer detractors.
en-US.Visual_Caption_NpsNeedsN: A change of this size would need n≈{0} per wave to be significant.
en-US.Visual_Caption_SigCount: {0} of {1} statements differ significantly from the rest.
en-US.Visual_Caption_XtabSig: {0} of {1} tested cells are significantly higher than another column.
en-US.Visual_ExportCsv_Title: Download this table as CSV, letters included
en-US.Visual_Landing_Hint: Pick a view — Likert battery, Crosstab or NPS — then add Question, Answer and a Value (e.g. Count of RespondentID). Segment adds comparison groups with significance letters, Wave tracks NPS over time; weighted results: use Sum of Weight as Value.
en-US.Visual_Landing_ScaleHint: The Answer field needs the scale's categories (e.g. 1–5). Mark non-scale answers as N/A in Format → Scale.
en-US.Visual_Landing_ScaleTitle: Add at least two scale answers
en-US.Visual_Landing_ScoreHint: For the NPS view the Answer field must contain the 0–10 likelihood-to-recommend scores.
en-US.Visual_Legend_Arrows: ▲ ▼ = top box significantly above / below the other statements ({0} % confidence).
en-US.Visual_Legend_Index: Cells = index vs Total (100 = same share as the Total column).
en-US.Visual_Legend_Letters: A/B/C = significantly higher than that segment ({0} % confidence); * = base below {1}, not tested.
en-US.Visual_Legend_LettersColumns: A/B/C = significantly higher than that column ({0} % confidence); * = base below {1}, not tested.
en-US.Visual_Legend_Moe: ± = margin of error of the top box ({0} % confidence).
en-US.Visual_Legend_NpsChange: ✓ = change vs the previous wave is significant ({0} % confidence); (n.s.) = not significant.
en-US.Visual_Legend_NpsMoe: ± / band = margin of error of the score ({0} % confidence).
en-US.Visual_Legend_VsTotal: ▲ ▼ = significantly above / below the rest of the sample ({0} % confidence).
en-US.Visual_Legend_WaveDeltaTested: ▲ ▼ = change vs {0} in percentage points; ✓ = significant ({1} % confidence).
en-US.Visual_Nps_GapHint: To reach {0}: {1} more promoters or {1} fewer detractors (n={2})
en-US.Visual_Role_answer_desc: Scale answers in model sort order (use Sort By Column); for the NPS view the 0–10 likelihood-to-recommend score
en-US.Visual_Role_benchmark_desc: Optional: a norm or benchmark for each statement's top box, as a fraction (0.62) or percent (62) — the delta shows next to the net
en-US.Visual_Role_group_desc: Optional: the section a statement belongs to (Leadership, Tools, …) — drawn as a header with its pooled score
en-US.Visual_Role_questionText_desc: Optional: the full wording behind a short question code — shown in tooltips, the caption and the footnote
en-US.Visual_Role_question_desc: Likert and Crosstab: one row / table block per question. NPS: leave empty or filter to the recommend question
en-US.Visual_Role_segment_desc: Optional (premium): comparison groups — Likert segments, Crosstab banner columns, NPS segments — with significance letters
en-US.Visual_Role_value_desc: Respondent count — or Sum of Weight for weighted results
en-US.Visual_Role_wave_desc: Optional: tracker mode — NPS trend over waves; Likert and Crosstab show the latest wave with the change since the previous one
en-US.Visual_Role_weightsq_desc: Optional: SUM(weight²) enables effective bases for weighted significance testing
